blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) on Wednesday invited the camp of Vice President Sara Duterte to properly discuss and open a formal investigation into the alleged threats received by her former staff. Duterte’s legal counsel, Atty. Paolo Panelo, on Tuesday disclosed that her former household staff reached out for help after being held in captivity by certain individuals. READ: Sara Duterte camp: Ex-staffers pressured to make false claims vs VP The unnamed staff members were reportedly threatened to sign a document containing false allegations against the vice president.
